title: YAGO Schema Manifest v1.0.0
description: JSON Schema for YAGO schema manifest files version 1.0.0. Schemas are indexed as '<namespace>-<version>-<kind>'. Documents can optionally specify a 'namespace' field at root level; if omitted, defaults to 'yago'.

name.description: Display name for the schema collection

description.description: Optional description of the schema collection purpose

namespace.description: Schema namespace identifier. Can be any alphanumeric string with hyphens, underscores, dots, and colons (e.g., 'yago', 'my-org', 'aws_provider', 'io.k8s.api', 'org:team:project'). Core YAGO schemas use 'yago' namespace. Schemas are indexed as '<namespace>-<version>-<kind>' internally. Documents can optionally specify a 'namespace' field at root level to use schemas from different namespaces.

schemas.description: List of schema definitions in this collection

kind.description: Document kind this schema applies to

file.description: Path to the JSON schema file (relative to manifest)
